statement: SK Hynix's board approved a 7.0931 trillion won ($4.83 billion) investment in the P&T7 advanced-packaging facility in Cheongju to accelerate cleanroom openings and expand HBM capacity.
why: Advanced packaging is the physical chokepoint on HBM output, so committed capital that pulls cleanroom openings forward is the clearest sign of future memory bit supply.

impact.mechanism: Capital committed to advanced-packaging cleanrooms raises future HBM assembly capacity, which relieves the packaging constraint that limits accelerator shipments.

evidence.excerpt: a 7.0931 trillion won ($4.83 billion) investment in its P&T7 advanced-packaging facility in Cheongju
accelerating the opening of new clean rooms and expanding capacity for High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) chips
secure a production base in Cheongju, Korea in response to global demand for AI memory semiconductors.
Key timeline: Start Date November 26, 2025; Projected End Date December 31, 2032.

confidence.basis: Single open-web outlet reporting a board decision; capacity added and timing are not quantified, and the dollar conversion varies across sources.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.88 -> 4.83 (tol 1%); sources: StockTitan (SEC/6-K filing aggregator), ad-hoc-news.de
